paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: Length extrapolation results on EgoSchema dataset.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of frames and accuracy percentage for different models. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames," has a linear scale, ranges from 10 to 60, and is marked at intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale, ranges from 40 to 54, and is marked at intervals of 2. The plot contains four lines: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" in blue with a solid line and circular markers, "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" in green with a solid line and circular markers, "PLLLaVA (DP 8)" in orange with a solid line and square markers, and "PLLLaVA (DP 16)" in red with a solid line and square markers. The blue line starts at around 52.8% accuracy at 8 frames and increases to approximately 54.2% at 64 frames. The green line begins at around 52.7% accuracy at 8 frames and rises to about 54.1% at 64 frames. The orange line commences at roughly 45% accuracy at 8 frames and declines to approximately 39.5% at 64 frames. The red line starts at around 46% accuracy at 8 frames and decreases to about 42% at 64 frames.
